== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Our First Catch Of The Day (Japanese)|Our First Catch Of The Day]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/1998-decipher-star-wars-ccg-japanese-hoth-robert-john/imagegallery/32924 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/154944009/TUJdVJ2KYkWoAYvPTStWpQ.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 88099880.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>71dd9725b94de66b86e23bc679c18ad1a672eef91062d83fa3e1c2a59b69deee</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
